## 3dslibris 3.0.0

Search your books and take a closer look at their illustrations.

### New

- [Book search (#163)](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/163): find words and phrases with the 3DS keyboard, highlight matches and move between results. Available in EPUB, MOBI, TXT, Markdown, FB2, RTF and ODT through the BOOK menu.
- [Image viewer (#28)](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/28): zoom and pan illustrations in EPUB, MOBI and FB2. Hold Y to select an image, then press A to open it. Includes touch controls and returns to your reading position.
- Optional `disable ebook images` setting under `style customization`.

### Fixes and improvements

- Fix overlapping full-page images and preserve authored image sizes across reading screens.
- Correct orientation and handedness controls, landscape buttons, loading screens and partial redraws.
- Show two lines for library titles and load folder covers only when visible and idle.
- Fix a [CJK pagination stack overflow (#165)](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/165), parsing errors, image-loading limits and invalid page-cache handling.

### Updating

EPUB and MOBI page caches are rebuilt on first open after updating. Reading progress, bookmarks and preferences are kept.

Search does not support PDF/CBZ/XPS, OCR or RTL text. See the [search guide](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/blob/main/docs/BOOK_SEARCH.md) and [image controls](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/blob/main/docs/IMAGE_VIEWER.md) for details.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone reporting issues and supporting the project. You can help with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
